name: Seminoe State Park (Sunshine Beach Campground)
note: Sunshine Beach is the park's southernmost campground, just southeast of South Red Hills on Seminoe Reservoir, about 35 mi north of Sinclair via County Road 351 and a mile of gravel road: gravel sites, a few with shade shelters, in loops on two low points and along the road between, on open sage ground above the sandy shore the park calls its most popular swimming area. No trees. Drinking water is at North and South Red Hills in summer, the dump station at North Red Hills. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: reserve.wyoming.gov (US eDirect API wyordr.usedirect.com/wyomingrdr/rdr/, PlaceId 14 'Seminoe State Park', FacilityId 383 'Sunshine Beach', read 2026-11-20): 31 web-bookable units (AllowWebBooking true) - 23 'Campsite Non-Electric' SB71-SB74, SB80-SB93, SB96-SB99, S100 (IsRVSite true, 'Unit&parkingsize' 40 on every unit, 'Parking Pad Material' Gravel on 22 and Paved on SB80, campsite dimensions 45x21 to 100x22 ft) + 8 pull-through Group Sites (SB75-SB79, SB94, SB95, S101) -> real drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. Esri imagery shows gravel loops and spurs on sage ground, not camping on the open sand (sand rule passes). The Dyrt (Sunshine Beach, review Jun 10, 2024): 'One mile of gravel road to the campground', $10/night, 'Big Rig Friendly'. Not in the DB: entries within 2 km are 15731 South Red Hills (FacilityId 382, 0.8 km NW) and 6360 North Red Hills (FacilityId 381, 1.3 km N), separate facilities; no name match. Public (state): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World Imagery 900 m frame over the whole campground and 260 m / 220 m frames over the east loop and the south point, every reserve.wyoming.gov unit point (grid MapInfo, FacilityId 383) plotted; images rendered. Full pool 6,357.0 ft NGVD29 = 1938.7 m NAVD88 (figure from the 15731 South Red Hills audit the same day: Reclamation allocation table + NOAA VERTCON); USGS 3DEP lidar (epqs.nationalmap.gov) water surface 1932.0 m at capture; imagery water 100-200 m from the east loop and ~40-60 m from the south point. Pads sit only ~0.4-2 m above full pool. Profiles from pad ends (spur ends located on the imagery, not the engine points) to the 1938.7 m contour over open bare ground: east loop end spur (SB88, 42.12697,-106.88921, pad 1939.0 m) ~12-15 m E on a gentle slope (1937.2 m at 16 m); SB85/SB86 spurs (pad 1939.2 m) ~13-15 m S, nearly flat (1938.2 m at 13 m) toward the shallow cove; SB89/SB90 north side ~8 m to a ~3 m eroded scarp (1939.5 -> 1936.3 m in 8 m); south point SB72/SB73 (pad 1940.8-1942.0 m) ~10-20 m down a ~24% sand slope (1940.8 -> 1938.4 m in 10 m); SB71, SB74 and the road-side group sites 30-60 m and higher. Measured alone, SB85-SB88 and SB72/SB73 would meet the open-apron rule at full pool. Held at lakeview because: every one of the 31 units is tagged 'Waterfront Setting: None' by the booking engine; the park names Sunshine Beach its most popular swimming area and its beach areas are day use, and the swim beach (likely the shallow sand bay south of the east loop that SB85/SB86 face) could not be placed against the sites (wyoparks.wyo.gov unread, F5 challenge); unsure -> downgraded. View floor: open sage points with no trees, the reservoir unscreened on two or three sides of every loop.

fees.note: $10 a night for Wyoming residents, $18 for others, plus the day-use fee, $7 a vehicle for residents and $12 for others, plus sales and lodging tax. The booking site shows 'Fees Range From $23-41' on the campsites.

flags: Waterfront held at lakeview, but the measurement is close to lakefront: pads sit 0.4-2 m above full pool and the full-pool line is ~12-15 m from the east-loop end spur (SB88) and SB85/SB86, ~10-20 m from SB72/SB73 on the south point, over open bare ground. Downgraded because the engine tags every unit 'Waterfront Setting: None' and the park's day-use swim beach (its 'most popular swimming area') could not be placed against the sites. The reviewer may judge SB85-SB88 / SB72-SB73 a few clear lakefront sites with a caveat. At the imaged and lidar water levels the shore is 40-200 m off.
Site count: engine 23 campsites + 8 group sites; Campflare says 38, Hipcamp 30.
